chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:

Indeed, for Allah, Exalted and Glorious, there are creations whom He created from His Light, and a mercy from His mercy for His mercy; they are the Eye of Allah that sees, and His Ear that hears, and His Tongue that speaks among His creation by His permission, and His Trustees over what He has sent down of justification or warning or proof. By them Allah erases misdeeds, and by them He repels grievance, and by them He sends down mercy, and by them He gives life to the dead and causes the living to die, and by them He tests His creation, and by them He decides a decision among His creation. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, who are these? He said: The Successors.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'creations from Allah's light' mentioned in the hadith of Maani al-Akhbar?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the Awtad (Successors) as the 'Ayn Allah' (Eye of God) and 'Lisan Allah' (Tongue of God), emphasizing their ontological status as created from divine light. This concept underscores their role as the primary trustees (Amanah) through whom divine proofs are manifested, sins erased, and decrees executed, linking the metaphysical reality of the Imams to their functional authority in guiding creation.

en.basel-kadem: 10.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed ibn ‘Isa, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Fadala bin Ayub, from Aban bin Uthman, from Muhammed bin Muslim, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:

Indeed, to Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, there are creations which He created from His Light, and a mercy from His mercy to His mercy; they are the observing Eye of Allah, and His hearing Ear, and his Tongue that speaks with his creation by His permission, and His Guardians upon what He has sent down of Justification, Warning or Proof. Hence, by them Allah erases misdeeds, and by them He repels grievance, and by them He sends down mercy, and by them He brings life into a dead and makes dead a living, and by them He tests His creation, and by them He decides in His creation His decision. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, who are these? He said: The Successors.
